description_zh: 调用ScrollDomainList翻页遍历域名列表
kebab_example: aliyun domain scroll-domain-list --end-expiration-date 1541520000000 --user-client-ip 127.0.0.1 --lang en --start-expiration-date 1541520000000 --product-domain-type gTLD --page-size 50 --domain-group-id 123456 --domain-status 0 --end-length 3 --excluded test --excluded-prefix false --excluded-suffix true --form 1 --key-word test --key-word-prefix true --key-word-suffix false --start-length 0 --trade-type -1 --suffixs com --start-registration-date 1541520000000 --end-registration-date 1541520000000 --scroll-id test --resource-group-id rg-acfmw6bpc6n7zai --api-version 2018-01-29 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ScrollDomainList

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query domain names based on expiration dates. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询域名到期日期范围的结束时间，计算方式为UTC时间1970年1月1日0点距离现在的毫秒数
parameters.name: end_expiration_date

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the client. Set the value to 127.0.0.1
parameters.help_zh: 用户IP，可设置为127.0.0.1
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of the error message to return if the request fails. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.
en: English.

Default value: en
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query domain names based on expiration dates. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询域名到期日期范围的开始时间，计算方式为UTC时间1970年1月1日0点距离现在的毫秒数
parameters.name: start_expiration_date

parameters.help_en:
The type of the domain name. Valid values:

New gTLD
gTLD
ccTLD
other
parameters.help_zh:
域名类型。取值：
New gTLD。
gTLD。
ccTLD。
other
parameters.name: product_domain_type

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 域名列表的分页大小
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the domain name group. You can call the QueryDomainGroupList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69362.html) operation to obtain the ID of the domain name group
parameters.help_zh: 域名分组ID，可通过QueryDomainGroupList (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69362.html)接口获取
parameters.name: domain_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the domain name. Valid values:

0: All.
1: The domain name needs to be renewed.
2: The domain name needs to be redeemed.
3: The domain name is normal.
4: The domain name is being transferred from Alibaba Cloud.
5: The information about the domain name registrant is being modified.
6: Real-name verification is not performed on the domain name.
7: Real-name verification for the domain name fails. Real-name reverification is required.
8: The domain name is being reviewed
parameters.help_zh:
域名状态。取值：
0：全部。
1：急需续费。
2：急需赎回。
3：正常。
4：正在转出万网。 
5：域名持有者信息修改中。
6：未实名认证。
7：审核失败，重新实名认证。
8：审核中
parameters.name: domain_status

parameters.help_en: The end of domain name length to query
parameters.help_zh: 查询域名长度范围的结束长度
parameters.name: end_length

parameters.help_en: The keyword that is used to exclude domain names
parameters.help_zh: 排除关键字
parameters.name: excluded

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to exclude the prefix keyword
parameters.help_zh: 开头排除关键字
parameters.name: excluded_prefix

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to exclude the suffix keyword
parameters.help_zh: 结束排除关键字
parameters.name: excluded_suffix

parameters.help_en: The composition of the domain name
parameters.help_zh: 域名组成信息
parameters.name: form

parameters.help_en: The keyword
parameters.help_zh: 关键字
parameters.name: key_word

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the keyword is the prefix
parameters.help_zh: 开头关键字
parameters.name: key_word_prefix

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the keyword is the suffix
parameters.help_zh: 结束关键字
parameters.name: key_word_suffix

parameters.help_en: The start of the domain name length to query
parameters.help_zh: 查询域名长度范围的开始长度
parameters.name: start_length

parameters.help_en:
The publishing status of the domain name. Valid values:

2: The domain name is published at a fixed price.
3: The domain name is published with the price negotiable.
4: The domain name is published for bidding.
6: The domain name is published with price push.
-1: The domain name is not published
parameters.help_zh:
发布状态。取值：
2：已发布一口价。
3：已发布线上议价。
4：已发布竞价。
6：已发布带价push。
-1：未发布域名交易
parameters.name: trade_type

parameters.help_en: The suffixes of domain names to be queried. Separate multiple suffixes with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 查询后缀列表，以逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: suffixs
